ideas.title: Pure Functional Game Engine
ideas.description: Stateless functions: position→moves, position+move→position, position→status. No side effects, no mutation.

ideas.title: CSS Grid + Data-Attribute Event Delegation
ideas.description: 11x11 CSS Grid, data-action attributes, LINKER event delegation. No canvas.

ideas.title: Redux State + Pure Engine Bridge
ideas.description: GameState in Redux store, pure engine validates moves, reducers apply. Time-travel debugging for free.

ideas.title: Minimax AI with Alpha-Beta Pruning
ideas.description: Asymmetric evaluation: attackers maximize captures, defenders maximize king escape routes.

ideas.title: WebGPU Visual Layer
ideas.description: Spring animations, blur effects, glow on selection, particle effects on capture.

ideas.title: Sound via Web Audio Bridge
ideas.description: 30-50 line JS AudioContext bridge. Stone placement, capture, victory sounds.

ideas.title: Viking SVG + WebGPU Aesthetic
ideas.description: SVG Viking knotwork, rune typography, WebGPU-powered blur/glow everywhere.

ideas.title: Game History + Replay via Move List
ideas.description: Move list is the event log. Replay by replaying moves through pure engine.

ideas.title: Online Multiplayer via Iroh P2P
ideas.description: Post-MVP: Iroh WASM P2P for multiplayer. Game state sync via move list.

ideas.title: Accessibility ARIA Grid
ideas.description: ARIA grid role, arrow key navigation, screen reader announcements for moves/captures.

caveats: Single-thread WASM blocks UI during deep search
Needs cooperative yielding or Web Worker escape hatch
Iroh WASM integration into LINKER is a separate project

implementation_phases.name: Pure Functional Game Engine
implementation_phases.description: Core game logic as pure functions. Position, moves, captures, win conditions. Swift test only, no LINKER dependency.

implementation_phases.name: Redux State + CSS Grid UI + Keyboard/ARIA
implementation_phases.description: Wire engine to Redux store. CSS Grid board. Event delegation. Move history. Full keyboard navigation and ARIA grid.

implementation_phases.name: WebGPU Visual Polish + SVG Viking Assets + Audio
implementation_phases.description: WebGPU blur/glow effects. SVG Viking knotwork pieces. Spring animations. Web Audio sounds.

implementation_phases.name: Minimax AI Opponent
implementation_phases.description: Asymmetric evaluation function. Alpha-beta pruning. Cooperative yielding for UI responsiveness.

implementation_phases.name: Post-MVP: Iroh P2P Multiplayer
implementation_phases.description: Integrate Iroh WASM into LINKER. P2P game state sync via move list. Deferred.

handoff_context.recommended_start: Phase A: Pure Functional Game Engine
key_decisions: WebGPU for all visual effects (no CSS effects)

payload.reasoning: 28 distinct behaviors across 7 groups. Multiple interacting rules (capture depends on position type, king has special capture rules, hostile squares). Multi-module system.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Place pieces in Copenhagen starting position
Piece cannot move through other pieces
Piece cannot move to occupied square
Only king can land on corner squares
No piece can re-enter vacated throne
Generate all legal moves for current player
King on throne captured by 4 adjacent attackers
King adjacent to throne captured by 3 attackers + throne
King elsewhere captured by standard custodial
Defenders win when king reaches corner

risks: King capture has 4 cases depending on throne proximity
Hostile squares interact with both regular and king capture
